ModMetaData.name: Overlord
ModMetaData.author: BroTeamPill
ModMetaData.description:
Let other people control your colonists from a browser. Assign a colonist and they get a live control panel with skills, needs, health, map view, and full pawn commands.
Two ways to play: - With friends: leave the Relay URL blank in Mod Settings. The mod serves the page itself, friends open your local address and type any name. No Twitch, no relay, no streaming. - Online or with Twitch viewers: the official Overlord relay is filled in by default. Press Set me up and share the link it copies. You can replace the address with a compatible relay you run yourself.
Mobile-first UI, narrow Harmony patch surface. Setup guide: https://github.com/scheissgeist/Overlord/blob/master/docs/HOSTING_GUIDE.md
Inspired by Puppeteer (Andreas Pardeike / Brrainz). New codebase for RimWorld 1.5/1.6; not affiliated with Puppeteer.
